all.label: All messages
all.description: Get notified when anyone sends a message in this server.

mentions.label: Mentions and direct mentions
mentions.description: Notify for @you, replies, and broadcast pings such as @everyone, @here, @channel, or role-style mentions.

mentions_direct.label: Direct mentions only
mentions_direct.description: Only when you are personally @mentioned, not via @everyone, @here, @channel, or roles.

none.label: Nothing
none.description: No push or desktop alerts from this server (still shows in the app).
